strips.title: A year with the car gifts — in real life

panels.head: Dec 25 — unwrap
panels.text: The jump starter goes in the trunk with a calendar reminder: recharge every couple of months.

panels.head: Jan — first cold snap
panels.text: The scraper and brush clear the roof as well as the glass.

panels.head: Feb — dead battery
panels.text: The starter turns it over. Owners say a unit left uncharged for months may not.

panels.head: Spring — tire check
panels.text: Pressure from the door-jamb label, cold, by gauge, not by the dashboard light.
